subject: english
question:
Select the incorrectly spelt word from the given sentence.

An increasingly smart navigation aids in the cockpit brought far greater precision and effeciency to route planning.
solution:
The incorrect spelling is: **effeciency**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word "effeciency" is incorrectly spelt. The correct spelling is** "efficiency"**.
 
• **"Efficiency"** means the state or quality of being efficient, or able to accomplish something with the least waste of time and effort; competency in performance. (कुशलता)
 
 
• **Example: **The new software increases the efficiency of the data processing system.
 
 

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Option 1** i.e. "effeciency".

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Precision** (सटीकता): The quality, condition, or fact of being exact and accurate.

 
 
• **Example:** The surgeon's precision during the operation was remarkable.
 
 
 
• **Navigation** (नेविगेशन): The process or activity of accurately ascertaining one's position and planning and following a route.
 
 
• **Example:** Modern navigation systems make it easy to find your way even in unfamiliar places.
 
 
 
• **Increasingly** (बढ़ते हुए): To an increasing extent; more and more.
 
 
• **Example:** The team is increasingly confident about their chances of winning.
